notes: Complete list: 3 actions (src/actions.js) and 7 boolean feedbacks (src/feedbacks.js); each file registers its definitions in a single call. Variables and presets are not catalogued.

Protocol: Socket.IO (socket.io-client) connection to the Tally Arbiter server (config default port 4455; config also has login fields for Tally Arbiter 3.3+). All dropdowns are filled from data the server pushes (sources, devices, bus options, listener clients, TSL clients, cloud destinations), so no list can be enumerated offline.

Definitions are rebuilt on server events (src/api.js: initActions on "devices" and "listener_clients", initFeedbacks on most events). The default of each device/source/client dropdown is the first array entry, which is the placeholder "0" until the server has sent data.
listener_clients_array contains only clients that are currently active; the feedback "listener_clients" therefore offers only active clients in its dropdown.

Actions send Socket.IO events through sendCommand(): "flash" with the listener client id, and "reassign" with listener client id, old device id and new device id (src/actions.js:20, 38, 67). flash_device flashes every listener client whose deviceId equals the selected device.
The ids of the server-filled dropdowns are copied unchanged from the server data (the module does not convert them); only the placeholder id "0" is known to be a string, so no valueType is declared.
Built on @companion-module/base ^1.10.0: options do not support expressions.
